# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.88

This release prevents mini-game coin earnings from being lost when the game is
saved.

## Fixed

- Serialized offline save writes so an older snapshot cannot overwrite a newer
  coin balance after a mini-game payout.
- Preserved every Coin Rush, Delivery Dash, and Hide & Seek reward when players
  already have coins or completed quests.
- Kept the newest mini-game balance as the final persisted save even when an
  earlier save operation is still running.

## Regression coverage

- Added exact balance-delta tests for all three mini games.
- Added an overlapping-save test that reproduces and prevents stale coin
  snapshots from replacing a newer reward balance.
- Re-ran the complete browser mini-game flow covering gameplay and HUD updates.

## Android updates

- Uses the production package ID `com.blockbuddies.offline`.
- Retains the exact v1.5.79 update-signing identity so existing installations
  can update normally.

## Included files

- `BlockBuddies-Offline-v1.5.88.apk`

- `APK-BADGING.txt`
